By-law 507-2026 deleted that closing-hours restriction from § 545-282, in force since 2026-09-30 [1]. So the old limit no longer applies, and midnight closing on a Tuesday is no longer restricted by this section.

This was amended by By-law 507-2026, which deleted the hours restriction from § 545-282 and § 545-291, in force since 2026-09-30 [1]. Under the amended rules, the operating hour limit no longer applies, so you may stay open until midnight on a Tuesday.
